errors.text: All cited evidence concerns Ag or CoNiCrFeMn nanowires and does not support the proposed ordering, APBE, phase-boundary, or aging mechanism in AlCoCrFeNi2.1.
The proposed critical ordering threshold of SRO <0.6 is invented and unsupported.
The hypothesis inconsistently places recovery above 750°C even though the target transition includes ductility recovery at approximately 750°C.
